prompt: Vertical 9:16 photoreal cinematic, an open-air family enclosure beside a mud-brick house, its fence made of upright date-palm trunks, open to a bright blue sky. In the centre on a large woven palm-leaf mat: one large shared round wooden bowl (qasah) of tharid, torn flat bread soaked in meat broth, a basket of fresh dates, a few rounds of flat bread, and several plain clay cups arranged in a circle around the bowl as if many relatives will sit together. Soft afternoon sunlight, palm-leaf shadows, warm colours. No people, no hands, no text, no modern objects, no cutlery.
